description: Load an exported design into this graph. THE DOCUMENT SHAPE: {"nodes":[{"node_type":"Requirement","node_id":"req:x","properties":{...}}],"edges":[{"edge_type":"SATISFIES","from_id":"cap:x","to_id":"req:x","properties":{}}]}. Only `nodes` is required: `graph_id`, `stamp` and both hashes are OPTIONAL on the way in, and `edges` may be omitted. Endpoint types are recovered from the nodes in the document or from this graph; describe_schema lists each node_type's properties. EACH NODE IS STATED WHOLE: a node already here is replaced, so a property the document leaves out is removed; the reply counts each removal and change in `properties_removed` / `properties_changed`. A node is refused only when it lacks a required property. To EDIT existing nodes, pass `merge: true` (what the document omits is kept) or use create_nodes. Anything not in the document is left alone. Atomic: a document that fails validation leaves the graph untouched, and EVERY invalid item is reported in one response; an edge whose endpoint is missing is reported, not dropped. IDENTITY: an EMPTY store adopts the document's `graph_id` (`adopted_identity`); a store already holding one keeps its name. A document from a NEWER reflow2 is REFUSED unless `accept_newer`: it would write this binary's defaults onto what the newer one left implicit. `materialized` names every Type.property written that the document did not state. Ask for this when you want to load a design or model file that someone exported or sent you.

accept_newer.description:
Import a document stamped by a NEWER reflow2 than this server anyway.
Default false: such an import is REFUSED, because this binary would
write its own schema defaults onto every record the newer reflow2 left
implicit (853 AUTHORED_BY edges gained `role: author` that way on
2026-09-14) and nothing in the result would say so. Pass true only when
you mean to read it with this binary — the report's `materialized` field
then names exactly what was written that the document did not state.

document.description:
A document previously returned by `export_graph`. Omit when passing
`path`.

echo.description: What the reply carries. `receipt` (the default) names the node, echoes each stored value of at most 200 characters, gives longer ones by size, and names the snapshot that keeps anything a revise replaced. `node` returns the whole stored node and every prior value.

merge.description:
Keep what a partial node leaves out. Default false: the document states
each node WHOLE, so a property a node already holds and the document
omits is removed (a round trip reproduces the design; a document can
drop a property), and the reply counts it in `properties_removed`.
true: each node the design already holds takes the document's
properties and keeps every other one it has, as create_nodes does. A
node not yet in the design is written as stated either way.

path.description:
Read the document from this file instead — the committed design export,
usually. Prefer this to inlining: it avoids carrying a large document
through the conversation, and it records that this seat is now in step
with that file, which is what clears a `req:stale-seat-knows` refusal.

name: import_graph
title: Import a Design
